run_launch_evals: run the launch_evals CLI to submit SLURM jobs for evaluating model checkpoints across languages
run_get_checkpoints_to_run: run get_checkpoints_to_run to list available checkpoints and skip already evaluated ones
run_checkpoint_exists: run checkpoint_exists to check if evaluation results exist for a given model checkpoint
run_launch_slurm_job: run launch_slurm_job to write an sbatch script and submit it to the SLURM scheduler
run_parse_date: run parse_date to parse a date string in DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM:SS format into a datetime object
